data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'ρικός' (rikos) meaning 'powerful' and 'ρική' (riki) meaning 'ruler'. Ricoriki can be translated as 'powerful ruler'. The name Ricoriki carries the meaning “Powerful ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ricoriki usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
